[quote=british_calradia;61213180]The HMS Godiva's crew managed to bring the diplomatic team towards the "smaller vessel" entrance of the ship. The diplomatic team were taking towards the lower lobby of the ship and as they passed, it looked to the Balionic crewman and diplomatic team that they were distracted by the "sights" of the ship. As they stood in awe at the entrance of the "Grand Party" room of the ship, Mr X had to intervene and states; "Look gents, you lot can have a shot at this later on, we have to discuss important matters"

They reluctantly obliged and arrived at the meeting room in the opulent and scenic A deck. They were guided to their seats by the female servers in their unique clothing, with each of the people in the meeting having their own server. One of the Sikirskians just stood in front of his personal server oggling at her when she said "Come on now, we can meet later. Please sit down". Mr X subtly began to look frustrated at the Sikirskians who seemed to be too excited by what they had just seen. The door was closed and talks began. 

Mr X opened up with; "Well, it is nice to meet you, the new diplomatic team from Sikirsk's grand government to our ship. We don't have as much people from his majesty's side here, since it is only just a few of us here, but I am sure... AAAHHH WHAT WAS THAT?!?!?!" The Ship suddenly turned portside. spilling drinks, causing papers to fly all over the place and the female servers to loose their balance and fall onto the floor. The announcement speakers began to play; "Goooooood Evening Ladies and Gentlemen, this ship of fun will now return to Sikirsk and pick up a few more lucky ladies! Giggity Giggity" and that began to cut off as it seemed like there was a fight on the bridge of the ship.

"Oh dammit, not Quagmire!" said one of the Balionic diplomats. "Yeah sure about that, we have an ...... interesting man named G. Quagmire with us. He's a bit [i]strange[/i]" It seemed like the ship was going full speed towards Sikirsk and frantically swinging left and right. "Oh nooo!" screamed one of the female servers as she looked out of one of the windows. The HMS Godiva was about to go into the path of a small ocean liner, potentially causing a collision. The diplomatic team and a lot of guards began to rush the bridge of the ship. "Wait here, we have to fix this issue before it's too late"

The Sikirskians, in the midst of blaring alarms, fighting over the intercom, screaming, falling objects and hurried footsteps mistook Mr X's words as an order to help them, so they all went out towards the bridge. Once they got there, it seemed like it was too late. The small ocean liner slammed into the starboard side of the ship, causing a massive sound of clashing metal and going all of the way towards the end if the ship. "Oh wow, well at least their crew can enjoy our fun!" shrugged Quagmire. Everyone looked at him with anger and fear as the automatic safety doors in the lower decks shut automatically. The ship slowly began to sink and tilt starboard side. "Damn, well sorry this has happened. Seems like we need to get out on land" said Mr X.

A mayday call was sent for help as the ship's 15 thousand people began to panic  in shock and awe. [/quote]

Anyways....)

[i]The head diplomat shook his head, using his satellite telephone to contact port authorities. While lifting his jacket, his Ruger Mark IV in his belt is shown. He doesn't pay attention to it. Later, port authorities send a small flotilla of tugboats and a two large naval helicopters behind them. An attempt to tow the ship is made, however that doesn't work, they instead try to tackle the ship back upright utilizing the tugboats and the helicopter tow mechanisms. Which goes well. Reports from the small oceanliner show that their ship could withstand the blast and could make it back to port without much chaos. Dockworkers are sigh-hingly helping pump out water. During that, head diplomat and famous Sikirskian marksman, James Khirman, together with his soldier-bodyguard march back upwards to the bridge. They spot G. Quagmire. They aim at him with his Ruger, then proceed to take him to one of the speedboats travelling with the tugboats. He is then privately taken to a port a bit further away from New Liberatska port. Then handed to "SSB". Afterwards they return acting like nothin' happened. They consult Mr. X on the situation with the other ship and ask for them to really introduce some better security and shipfaring lessons to the crew.
